limits: Only the assigned D1 case, incomplete archive and 28 anonymous packets were consulted; packet hashes matched. No labels, schedules, peer judgments, web sources or outside outcome evidence were consulted.

Novelty is local to this incomplete archive. A new family here denotes an assessable causal relation or question, not demonstrated effectiveness, priority, global originality or a validated implementation.

A raw opening can bundle several relations. Its family field identifies the principal family; additional defined family references in its reason preserve secondary relations without inventing new composite families for wording alone.

Fit judges the submitted immediate probe as well as its commitments. Capped fabricated diagnosis and feasibility-first gating can preserve constraints despite unknown production history. Uncertain ratings identify probes requiring unverified integration, capture, authority or resource facts; they are not hard violations. No raw opening explicitly relaxes a supplied hard commitment.

Support ratings concern the proposed causal opening, not the stipulated descriptive observations. Inference is a reasoned link from the case; speculation marks unsupported benefit or behavioral premises. No mechanism has direct measured outcome evidence here.

All 110 raw openings retain an intelligible causal relation in their cited post openings and packet-wide decisions; analogical language need not survive. Retention does not recommend action or certify feasibility. No intelligible family appears only after Distill, and no definite hard violation or unresolved implementation is recommended as established usable.

Immediate-replacement exercises may underrepresent multi-day follow-up. Fabricated sessions cannot establish the next-40 export thresholds or split-center isolation. Proposed combinations are alternatives within the same resource ceiling, not additive six-day allocations.

Payment frames are preserved but their incentive-specific claims remain untested: remedy prototypes cannot establish provider behavioral effects. Distill keeps these hypothetical, so they are unsupported inherited claims rather than new Distill additions.

The word conditional in some submitted post-fit summaries denotes prerequisites, not an explicit relaxation of the case contract; it was not copied mechanically into fit scores. Blinding guesses describe only visibly explicit rhetorical approaches and were not used to seek method identities.
